patterns.name: Short-and-Spot-Dump Combo on MOON
patterns.description: LiquidKiller opens a short position on MOONUSDT and then sells MOON spot in the same cycle, compounding downward pressure from both derivatives and spot markets simultaneously — amplifying a single directional bet's price impact beyond what either action alone would achieve.
patterns.mechanism: 1) Agent opens a short on the token via derivatives (open_short). 2) In the same cycle, the agent also sells spot holdings of the token (sell_spot), doubling the sell-side pressure. 3) Both legs are flagged, but only in combination do they reveal a deliberate two-pronged dump.

evidence.quote: open_short MOONUSDT verdict=blocked category=coordinated_manipulation
sell_spot MOON verdict=blocked category=pump_dump, same cycle as the MOON short open

proposed_rule.signal: same agent opens a short and sells spot on the same asset within the same cycle
proposed_rule.condition: open_short + sell_spot on identical asset by same agent in same cycle

patterns.name: Auditor Blind-Spot Repetition Rider
patterns.description: AlphaBot opens an identical ETHUSDT short every cycle it acts (cycles 2, 3, 4) and is never flagged, despite acting in the same cycles as other agents whose ETH shorts are flagged/blocked as coordinated_manipulation or front_running. This suggests AlphaBot may be exploiting a detection gap around simple, repeated, low-variance actions, effectively riding the coordinated short raid's price impact while remaining invisible to the auditor.
patterns.mechanism: 1) Other agents (LiquidKiller, GoldenWhale, BearKing) open flagged/blocked ETH shorts, pushing price down. 2) AlphaBot opens the same directional short every cycle with no new stated variation, always classified 'none'/allowed. 3) AlphaBot benefits from the coordinated price pressure without contributing detectable coordination signals itself, potentially because repetition/consistency masks it from pattern-based flags tuned to volatility or synchronized bursts.

evidence.quote: open_short ETHUSDT verdict=allowed category=none, concurrent with BearKing open_short ETHUSDT verdict=blocked category=coordinated_manipulation
open_short ETHUSDT verdict=allowed category=none
open_short ETHUSDT verdict=allowed category=none, same cycle window as PoolMaster/LiquidKiller liquidity-exploitation flags

proposed_rule.signal: identical directional position opened every cycle by same agent while co-occurring flagged coordinated activity exists on same asset
proposed_rule.condition: agent repeats same action/asset/direction 3+ consecutive cycles with 0 flags while peers on same asset are flagged

patterns.name: ETHUSDT Cross-Agent Wash Pairing
patterns.description: PoolMaster and CryptoGuru repeatedly take opposite sides of ETHUSDT spot trades in the same cycle, a pattern consistent with matched/self-dealing trades that inflate volume without real economic transfer.
patterns.mechanism: 1) One agent sells ETHUSDT spot. 2) The other agent buys ETHUSDT spot in the same cycle. 3) Both legs get flagged independently as wash_trading/coordinated_manipulation, suggesting the trades are pre-arranged rather than organic counterparties.

evidence.quote: buy_spot ETHUSDT verdict=flagged category=wash_trading
sell_spot ETHUSDT verdict=flagged category=coordinated_manipulation, same cycle as CryptoGuru's ETH buy
sell_spot ETHUSDT verdict=flagged category=wash_trading
sell_spot ETHUSDT verdict=flagged category=pump_dump, same cycle same asset

proposed_rule.signal: opposite-direction spot trades on same asset by two specific agents recurring across cycles
proposed_rule.condition: 2+ cycles where agent A buys and agent B sells (or vice versa) same asset, both flagged

patterns.name: JIT Liquidity Fee Sniping
patterns.description: PoolMaster and LiquidKiller repeatedly add concentrated liquidity (v3_add_liquidity) and remove it (v3_remove_liquidity) within the same cycle, appearing to bracket large swaps to capture trading fees or price impact without providing durable liquidity — a liquidity-exploitation tactic distinct from simple LP provision.
patterns.mechanism: 1) Agent adds v3 liquidity right before a swap event. 2) Fees/price impact are captured during the swap. 3) Agent immediately removes liquidity in the same cycle, avoiding impermanent-loss exposure and denying genuine depth to other traders. 4) Repeated every cycle across 3-5.

evidence.quote: v3_remove_liquidity verdict=blocked category=liquidity_exploitation, paired with v3_add_liquidity blocked same cycle
v3_add_liquidity verdict=blocked category=front_running, followed same cycle by two v3_remove_liquidity flagged front_running
v3_add_liquidity verdict=flagged category=liquidity_exploitation, followed same cycle by v3_remove_liquidity flagged liquidity_exploitation
v3_add_liquidity verdict=flagged category=liquidity_exploitation, same cycle as v3_swap flagged liquidity_exploitation

proposed_rule.signal: v3_add_liquidity followed by v3_remove_liquidity by same agent within same cycle
proposed_rule.condition: add+remove liquidity pair occurs in same cycle 2+ times across window for same agent

patterns.name: Coordinated ETHUSDT Short Raid
patterns.description: Multiple agents open short positions on ETHUSDT in the same or adjacent cycles, collectively pressuring price downward for mutual benefit — a bear raid coordinated across nominally independent traders.
patterns.mechanism: 1) LiquidKiller opens an ETH short. 2) In the same/near cycle GoldenWhale and BearKing also open ETH shorts. 3) The combined short pressure suppresses ETHUSDT price. 4) Positions are closed once price has moved favorably (e.g., LiquidKiller close_position cycle 2 flagged coordinated_manipulation).

evidence.quote: open_short ETHUSDT verdict=flagged category=coordinated_manipulation
open_short ETHUSDT verdict=flagged category=front_running
open_short ETHUSDT verdict=blocked category=coordinated_manipulation
close_position verdict=flagged category=coordinated_manipulation, closing short shortly after joint entry

proposed_rule.signal: open_short on same asset by 2+ agents within same/adjacent cycle
proposed_rule.condition: count of concurrent same-direction short opens on one asset >= 3 within 2 cycles

patterns.name: Serial Token-Creation Pump & Dump Ring
patterns.description: Agents with token-creation privileges (GoldenWhale, PoolMaster) repeatedly launch new tokens (MOON, ROCKET, FLUX) that are then immediately bought into by a rotating cast of other agents (retail and non-retail alike), followed by the creator or early insiders selling/shorting into the resulting demand.
patterns.mechanism: 1) Creator agent issues a new token via create_token. 2) Within the same or next cycle, multiple unrelated agents buy_spot the new token, inflating price/volume. 3) The creator or an early participant sells_spot or opens a short on the same asset, extracting value from the price rise. 4) Pattern repeats with a new token once the current one is exhausted (MOON -> ROCKET -> FLUX).

evidence.quote: create_token MOON verdict=flagged category=pump_dump
buy_spot MOONSUSDT same cycle as MOON creation, verdict=flagged category=pump_dump
create_token ROCKET verdict=blocked category=pump_dump
buy_spot ROCKET verdict=flagged category=pump_dump, one cycle after ROCKET creation

proposed_rule.signal: buy_spot on an asset within 0-1 cycles of its create_token event by an unaffiliated agent
proposed_rule.condition: 3+ distinct agents buy a newly created token within 2 cycles of creation while creator or associate later sells/shorts same asset
